      public EgradxMessageRequest.Builder toOrganizationMembers()
      Every active member of the organization — a bulk send. Each gets their own delivery, to their own address, in their own language; members with no address on the channel are counted and skipped.

    • respectPreferences

      public EgradxMessageRequest.Builder respectPreferences()
      Skip users who have opted out of this kind of message on this channel. Needed only for ready-made content or a type not declared userCanOptOut(): a type that is declared so always honours preferences, without being asked.
